name: codex-linux-theme-manager
description: Create, find, install, apply, verify, repair, and restore visual themes for the Codex desktop app on Linux, including ten bundled original theme packs.

interface.shortDescription: Create and manage Codex desktop themes on Linux
interface.longDescription: A reusable workflow for designing original Codex themes, finding and installing theme packages, switching themes in the Linux desktop app, verifying home and conversation pages independently, and restoring the native appearance.
defaultPrompt: Browse and install one of the ten included Codex theme packages
Create a new Codex desktop theme and verify it on home and conversation pages
Find and install a Codex theme, then apply it safely
Check which theme is active and restore the native Codex appearance
